shard.name: Bedrock Dedicated Server
shard.description: Official Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server software (BDS) supporting mobile, console and Windows cross-play.
shard.author: Mojang Studios & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Bedrock BDS Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl jq unzip ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server

DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/download/server/bedrock | grep -o 'https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/[^"]*' | head -n 1)

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "Warning: Unable to scrape download link from website, using fallback release endpoint..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://minecraft.azureedge.net/bin-linux/bedrock-server-1.21.50.07.zip"
fi

echo "Downloading Bedrock Dedicated Server from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" -fSL -o bedrock-server.zip "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Extracting files..."
unzip -q -o bedrock-server.zip -x server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json
rm -f bedrock-server.zip

chmod +x bedrock_server
echo "Bedrock installation complete!"
